tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search BangkokVacay's curated directory of Bangkok, Thailand businesses (hotels, restaurants, bars, activities, attractions, shops and services). Read-only. Filters: keyword, category, area/neighborhood, price tier, amenities (e.g. pool, spa, river_view, rooftop, michelin), tag, and distance from a

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Read-only. Full details for one BangkokVacay listing by id: complete plain-text description, FAQ, hours, up to 10 gallery photos with captions and credits (e.g. 'Photo via Expedia'), listing page URL, and booking links (the path to book with the named provider, not ads). Links marked affiliate:true

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Read-only. List the BangkokVacay directory's top-level categories with listing counts.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: Read-only. Values usable in search_listings: areas/neighborhoods, price tiers, amenities and tags, each with listing counts, plus notes on how each is derived.

tools.name: search_tours
tools.description: Read-only. Live search of bookable tours and activities in Bangkok, Thailand from Viator's partner API. Returns title, live starting ('from') price and currency, rating, review count, duration, free-cancellation flag, image and a booking_url. Optional start_date/end_date return only products Viator
